newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Q2 GDP to be stronger than 96-Evans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Q2 GDP to be stronger than 96-Evans.

text.p: Australian Treasury secretary Ted Evans said on Monday economic growth in the June quarter would be stronger than a year earlier.

"We'll have those figures in a couple of weeks, but it does appear that the June quarter, like the March quarter, was also stronger than what was happening in calendar 1996," Evans told a parliamentary committee.
